factor_specs.formula: alpha_i = -corr(r_i_daily, r_mkt_daily) over rolling 252d window ending at month-end (PIT t<=sig_date); SMAX-orthogonalized then sector-neutralized cross-sectionally; beta_i = (sd_i/sd_mkt)*corr_i decomposed, correlation component isolated.
factor_specs.lag_rule: daily t-1 close; window ends AT month-end m, label = forward 1M return
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Asness-Frazzini-Gormsen-Pedersen 2020 JFE: beta=vol x corr; the CORRELATION component carries the genuine leverage/funding-constraint low-risk premium (co-moves with margin debt), while the vol component is contaminated by IVOL/lottery. Long low-correlation stocks should earn the funding-constrained premium and naturally diversify (low realized beta + low common-risk).

factor_specs.proxy: SMAX = mean of 5 largest daily returns (MAX(5))
factor_specs.formula: smax_i over same 252d window; used as orthogonalization control to disentangle BAC correlation premium from lottery/IVOL contamination
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Bali 2011: lottery (MAX) demand drives overpricing -> negative premium. Separated from BAC to ensure the correlation signal is clean (post-orthogonalization cor_vs_SMAX=0.025).
